name: Herbaceous Peony
material: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk
dimensions: Painting: 118.7 x 71.8 cm (46 3/4 x 28 1/4 in.); Overall with knobs: 226 x 84.4 cm (89 x 33 1/4 in.)
summary: Yun Shouping came from Piling (modern Changzhou), Jiangsu province, a center of floral, plant, and insect painting.
